scope: Candidate-only evidence gathered from public source pages for evidence packets. These records do not modify the benchmark manifest and do not promote any pair.
policy: Candidate evidence may reduce a blocker count but does not by itself promote a record.
Source IDs, licenses, disorder annotations, and stability ordering still require curator and reviewer sign-off before the canonical manifest changes.
Public COD coordinates are useful source candidates, but CrystalProbe must still verify that selected CIFs match the intended polymorph pair and that release terms are preserved.

candidates.stability_summary: Candidate literature consistently describes monoclinic paracetamol Form I as stable under usual or ambient conditions and orthorhombic Form II as metastable. This supports a candidate A>B label only if structure A is confirmed as Form I and structure B is confirmed as Form II.

stability_sources.title: Polymorph control in batch seeded crystallizers. A case study with paracetamol
stability_sources.evidence_note: States that Form I is monoclinic and most stable under usual temperatures, while Form II is orthorhombic and metastable.

stability_sources.title: Direct evidence of polyamorphism in paracetamol
stability_sources.evidence_note: Describes Form I as thermodynamically stable monoclinic paracetamol and Form II as metastable orthorhombic paracetamol at room-temperature crystallization conditions.

stability_sources.title: Higher density does not mean higher stability mystery of paracetamol finally unraveled
stability_sources.evidence_note: Candidate thermodynamic explanation source for Form I versus Form II stability; also represented by COD Form I structure entry 7105573.

A.source_note: COD page reports formula C8 H9 N O2, space group P 1 21/n 1, coordinates present, and no disorder.

B.source_note: COD page reports acetaminophen, space group P b c a, coordinates present, and no disorder.

remaining_manual_checks: Download or vendor the selected COD CIFs only if the release policy accepts them as public benchmark coordinates.
Verify that Form I/Form II labels in the benchmark manifest correspond exactly to COD:7105573 and COD:2105052.
Replace manifest TODO placeholders, including InChI, source IDs, CIF paths, disorder notes, and evidence notes.
Human-review the stability ordering and source mapping before changing curation_status to reviewed.
